verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a dedicated international trademark, copyright and advertising team of 35+ lawyers and paralegals that protects brands across nearly 200 jurisdictions, so trademark work exists as its own practice. The evidence never separately describes clearance searches, registration filings, or enforcement actions, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trademark clearance/search services, registration/prosecution workflow, brand enforcement work (e.g., oppositions, cease-and-desist, anti-counterfeiting litigation), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Cooley's international trademark, copyright and advertising team – 35+ lawyers and paralegals, one of the largest groups among AmLaw 50 firms – spans the US, UK and Europe
to protect brands across nearly 200 countries and jurisdictions worldwide
